integrity: Proof relies on exact mixed-volume projection and spherical integration; finite Python diagnostics do not prove universal quantifiers. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the Euclidean ball, its axial translated-intersection witness path, and a separate zonoid coefficient are covered; no general unconstrained auxiliary-body optimum is claimed. The lens support and mean width predate this normalized-ratio theorem.
